accessibility_source_findings.finding: Sortable column headers are <th> elements with an onClick only: no tabIndex, no inner <button>, no key handler. Sorting in Contracts and Entities is pointer-only. aria-sort is set correctly.

TypeFilterSelect renders a Radix SelectTrigger with no aria-label and no associated label; used on Entities and Relationships. This is the button-name finding from docs/A11Y_AUDIT.md:105-114 and is still present in current source.
Dashboard root is a <div> with a <header>; there is no <main> element or role=main anywhere in the shipped app (grep '<main' in dashboard/src matches only the visual-test atlas).

Campaign Finance (3 tables), Ownership and Gov Changes build their header rows from TableCell (<td>) instead of TableHead (<th>), so columns have no header semantics. The change-candidates table has no header row at all.

Same issue in the ownership holders table and the government-changes table (dashboard/src/components/GovernmentChanges.jsx:29-34); dashboard/src/components/GovernmentChangeCandidates.jsx:11-20 has body rows only.

Contract and entity rows are <tr role="button" tabIndex=0>, which replaces row semantics for assistive tech, and use focus:outline-hidden with only a background tint as the focus indicator. Keyboard activation (Enter/Space) is implemented.

Activity search input sits in a <label> containing only an icon, so its accessible name comes from the placeholder alone; outline is removed (outline-hidden). Phase filter buttons expose selection by colour only (no aria-pressed).

special_adjudications.question: 2. case-manager-phase-1-gui-gap: references, backend, mounting, dashboard callers, exact gap.
special_adjudications.answer: References: the exception itself at .federation/gui-capabilities.json:1747-1768 (owner jotaele44, tracking jotaele44/thehub-pr#56, expires 2027-01-31, renewed 2026-11-15; candidate_ids are GET /{case_id}, GET /{case_id}/{collection}, POST /{case_id}/claims, POST /{case_id}/claims/{claim_id}/evidence-relations); a copy in the generated artifacts/gui-capabilities-merged.json:2256; and one mention in .federation/gui-capabilities.extensions/case-manager-authorization-boundary.json:9. The same manifest classifies the rest as internal capability 'case-manager-backend' (line 644). Docs: docs/CASE_MANAGER_PHASE_1_API_CONTRACT.md:10 (run on port 8001), docs/GUI_AUDIT.md:36, docs/GAP_ANALYSIS_AND_OPTIMIZATION_2026-09.md:337-338 ('router remains unmounted on the main app'). Backend that exists: server/backend/case_manager_api.py - APIRouter prefix /cases with 3 GET routes (list, get, collection: evidence/claims/contradictions/events/leads/findings/snapshots/audit-events) and 11 POST command routes (create case, evidence-links, claims, claim evidence-relations, contradictions, contradiction resolution, leads, lead closure, findings, finding acceptance, snapshots); no PATCH/DELETE. server/backend/case_manager_auth.py - X-Case-Token verified against SHA-256 hashes in data/case_manager_identities.json, plus loopback. server/backend/case_manager_app.py - a separate FastAPI app (v0.13.0) that includes the router and adds GET /health. Domain layer in moneysweep/case_manager/ (SQLite, migrations/001_case_manager_v1.sql). Mounted in the desktop app: NO. desktop_app.py only adds the materialization router to main.app (line 26), and main.py includes api_keys, campaign_finance, government_changes, leaderboards and ownership routers (286-290). The only include of the case router is server/backend/case_manager_app.py:20; nothing launches that app (desktop/config.py:18 points at desktop_app; grep for case_manager_app finds only tests, docs and the manifest). Dashboard callers: NONE. grep for 'cases', 'case_manager', 'case-manager', 'X-Case' in dashboard/src, dashboard/tests and desktop/ returns no match; lib/api.js has no case function. Exact gap: the whole Case Manager is GUI-less and not served by the shipped desktop process. The exception names only the claim and evidence-relation workflows (4 endpoints), but in source all 14 /cases routes lack a UI, there is no place in the UI to supply the X-Case-Token, and the service would have to be started by hand with uvicorn on another port. So closing the gap needs (1) mounting or launching the service, (2) a token/identity entry path, and (3) screens for cases, evidence, claims, evidence relations, contradictions, leads, findings and snapshots.

special_adjudications.question: 4. Financial semantics in Contracts, Top Entities, Campaign Finance and Ownership: fields, labels, null rendering, mixed amounts.
special_adjudications.answer: CONTRACTS. One monetary field: awardAmount (from CSV column award_amount, server/backend/main.py:143). Table header label 'Amount' (dashboard/src/components/ContractsTable.jsx:69); detail sheet label 'Award amount' (line 109). Null handling: backend _num maps blank/unparseable to null (server/backend/main.py:82-90); fmtMoney(null/undefined) renders an em dash '—' (dashboard/src/lib/cs-format.js:5-6); a real 0 renders '$0'. Formatting is whole dollars, always USD - the row's currency field is returned (server/backend/main.py:144) but never displayed or used. Other blanks: awarding/contractor/municipio '—' (lines 84-86), period '?' (110), other sheet rows '—' (dashboard/src/components/DetailRow.jsx:6). StatsBar prints 'award amounts not populated in Tranche A' when no contract has an amount (dashboard/src/lib/cs-format.js:50-51, dashboard/src/components/StatsBar.jsx:43-45). TOP ENTITIES. One column, header 'Value' (dashboard/src/components/FinancialLeaderboards.jsx:99), showing row.metricValue as USD currency or '<number> <currency>' for non-USD (line 100). The measure name is not in the column header; it is shown as ranking.metricType in the caption 'Top N · ties included · <metricType> · N candidates' (line 98) and as definition.metric_type in the box above (line 92). Measures by category (config/financial_category_ontology.json): contract_award=AWARDED (sum of award_amount, server/backend/leaderboard_adapters.py:218,237,247); debt_issuance=DEBT_ISSUED_PAR; asg_emergency_purchase_source_native=ASG_EMERGENCY_PURCHASE_COST; federal_obligation / federal_grant / disaster_assistance / federal_assistance=OBLIGATED (sum of obligated_amount, lines 773,784); campaign_contribution_received=CONTRIBUTIONS_RECEIVED (sum of amount, lines 933,947); 13 further categories (PAID, FUNDED, LOAN_PRINCIPAL, GUARANTEED, etc.) have no adapter and return zero rows. There is no 'disbursement' or 'payment' ranking with data. Null handling: records with a missing amount are excluded and counted under 'Excluded' in the Reconciliation panel (adapters 219-221; UI line 109); missing currency -> 'Unresolved'; a category with no rows shows the sentence 'No certifiable ranking rows for this category. Missing adapters or source manifestations remain explicit rather than becoming false zero rankings.' (line 101), not a zero. Missing state badges render 'UNKNOWN' (line 14); candidateCount and snapshot count default to 0 (lines 98, 105). CAMPAIGN FINANCE. (i) Tile 'Signed amount' = summary.totalContributionAmount (dashboard/src/components/CampaignFinance.jsx:137); '—' if null, but the backend always returns a number (0 when nothing is materialized). (ii) Contributions table column 'Amount' = row.amount via fmtMoney (lines 36, 47): FEC contribution_receipt_amount or CEE/OCE amount (server/backend/campaign_finance.py:162,181). (iii) Entities table column 'Amount' = row.amount (lines 67, 78), which the backend sets only for recipient rows, from total_disbursements (server/backend/campaign_finance.py:269); candidate and committee rows carry no amount and render '—'. (iv) 'Federal outflows' tile is a row COUNT of FEC disbursements + independent expenditures, not money (line 140; server/backend/campaign_finance.py:121); 'Contribution rows', 'FEC', 'CEE + OCE' are also counts (default 0). Missing text fields render '—'. OWNERSHIP. No monetary field is displayed. Columns are Shares (integer), '% issuer' (percent_issuer_shares_computed) and '13F portfolio %' (percent_13f_reportable_value) (dashboard/src/components/OwnershipDeepDive.jsx:92-94, 108-110); null -> '—' via fmtInt/fmtPct (lines 15-23). market_value exists in the payload builder (moneysweep/capital_control/deep_dive.py:290) but is not rendered. Metric tiles are counts/states, defaulting to 0 or '—' (lines 59-64). PLACES WHERE DIFFERENT KINDS OF AMOUNT SHARE A LABEL OR ARE SUMMED (reported, not judged): (a) Campaign Finance uses the single label 'Amount' for contribution receipts in the Contributions view and for recipients' total_disbursements in the Entities view (dashboard/src/components/CampaignFinance.jsx:36 vs 67; server/backend/campaign_finance.py:162/181 vs 269). (b) 'Signed amount' adds FEC receipts + CEE amounts + OCE amounts into one figure across three sources (server/backend/campaign_finance.py:103-105, 120). (c) In the contributions feed a blank or unparseable amount is coerced to 0 by _amount (server/backend/campaign_finance.py:58-62) before reaching the UI, so a missing contribution amount displays as '$0', not '—'; the same coercion feeds the 'Signed amount' sum. This differs from Contracts, where blank stays null and shows '—'. (d) Top Entities shows awarded, obligated, debt-par, purchase-cost and contributions-received values under one 'Value' header, one category at a time; nothing in the UI sums across categories, and the measure is named in the caption. (e) The ASG emergency-purchase adapter reads a column named obligation_amount and reports it with metricType ASG_EMERGENCY_PURCHASE_COST (server/backend/leaderboard_adapters.py:406, 467, 480). (f) federal_assistance and disaster_assistance pool several source programmes (grants, fema_pa, fema_hmgp, cdbg_dr, hud, ...) into one OBLIGATED total per UEI (server/backend/leaderboard_adapters.py:840-871); fema_pa/fema_hmgp/cdbg_dr records are counted in both categories. (g) Outside the four views asked about: Municipios shows an unlabelled dollar figure that is the sum of award_amount per municipio, '—' when none are populated (dashboard/src/components/MunicipalityAggregates.jsx:51; server/backend/main.py:239-245), and Relationships shows an unlabelled edge amount only when non-null (dashboard/src/components/RelationshipGraph.jsx:42).

special_adjudications.question: 5. Desktop conventions: recently opened items, pinned items, user rename.
special_adjudications.answer: Recently opened items: NONE FOUND. Pinned items: NONE FOUND. User rename of any object: NONE FOUND. The only browser storage the app touches is one localStorage key prefix, federation.programActivity.v1.<producerId> (dashboard/src/components/programActivityEvent.js:3), read by readLiveProgramActivity (line 51) to merge activity events into the Activity tab. Its writer appendProgramActivityEvent (line 64) has no caller in dashboard/src outside its test. It holds activity events, not a recents or pins list. The prebuilt desktop bundle (desktop/prebuilt-dashboard/bundle/assets/index-xHPKZVps.js) contains the same key and no other localStorage key. No sessionStorage or IndexedDB use was found. Desktop: the only remembered user choice is the single workspace folder picked in the external Setup & Diagnostics centre. It is applied from saved state at launch (desktop/launch.py:33-43; desktop/config.py:34-37). It is one saved value, not a list of recent workspaces, and its UI lives in the external prii_desktop package, which is not in the snapshot. Rename: there are no PATCH routes on any backend, and the case manager has only create/command POSTs (server/backend/case_manager_api.py:200-374), with case_id derived deterministically from title/type/scope (server/backend/case_manager_api.py:203), so a case title cannot be renamed. The dashboard has no rename or edit-label control. Searched (case-insensitive): localStorage|sessionStorage|indexedDB and recent|pinned|pin|favorite|favourite|bookmark|rename over dashboard/src, desktop/*.py, desktop/prebuilt-dashboard bundle and server/backend/*.py. Every match outside the program-activity module was in a test (programActivityEvent.test.js, cs-format.test.js), and the 'renamed' match there is test data for an event title.

unknowns: prii_desktop (desktop window, SPA serving, 'Setup & Diagnostics' centre) is an external package pinned in requirements-desktop.txt:5 and is not in the snapshot, so its routes, windows and settings UI were not audited.
